summary: Resolved the side-chain-context cross-framework divergence in aminx ProteinFeaturesLigand. Root cause: _make_angle_features used the einsum subscript 'lqp, lym -> lyp' (ligand_features.py:171); q and m each appear in only one operand and not in the output, so einsum summed both independently — (sum_q R[l,q,p])*(sum_m diff[l,y,m]), an outer product of column-sums instead of the frame projection e_p.diff. The handoff's prime hypothesis (atom37 slot-ordering) was falsified: the parity test feeds the SAME xyz_37 (from aminx parse_structure) to BOTH frameworks, so an input-ordering issue would affect both equally and they'd still agree — the divergence had to be feature-construction math. Fixed to 'lqp, lyq -> lyp'.
